communicationRules.rules.communication.surfaceInterval: mission time between surfacing windows; defaults to 3
communicationRules.rules.communication.surfaceDuration: visible surfacing transition duration; defaults to 0.25
communicationRules.rules.communication.updatePenalty: number applied per replanned event when scoring enables update penalties

deploymentRules.agents[].deployment.mode: fixedStart | chooseFromZone; missing deployment with agent.start defaults to fixedStart
deploymentRules.agents[].deployment.selectedStart: actual chosen start cell; may be null until player/solver chooses a deployment cell
deploymentRules.agents[].start: fixed-start compatibility field; selectedStart is authoritative after deployment selection

generatedScenarioSetup.mission.meta.scenarioSetup: player-selected setup preserved for generated challenges: missionMode, agentCount, grid, durationHours, surfaceIntervalHours, fuelPerAgent, gliderSpeed, difficulty, hazard/current/ROI/star settings
generatedScenarioSetup.mission.meta.missionMode: Challenge Mode objective preset id when the mission was generated from a mission card
generatedScenarioSetup.agents: generated challenge agents use glider_01, glider_02, etc. up to the browser-safe cap
generatedScenarioSetup.communication: surfaceInterval is set from the setup screen and usually matches level.world.time.planningWindow

endConditionRules.rules.endCondition.mode: none | surface | communication | recovery | pickup | return; defaults to none
endConditionRules.rules.endCondition.requiredByMissionEnd: boolean; if true, failing the condition marks recoverySuccess false and can apply penalty
endConditionRules.rules.endCondition.targetZoneId: optional zone id from rules.endCondition.zones, rules.recoveryZones, rules.communicationZones, or level bases
endConditionRules.rules.endCondition.penalty: score penalty applied when requiredByMissionEnd is true and not achieved

samplingRules.rules.sampling.mode: unique | diminishing | cooldown | persistent; defaults to unique
samplingRules.rules.sampling.duplicateValueMultiplier: value multiplier for repeated samples in unique/cooldown modes; defaults to 0
samplingRules.rules.sampling.localDepletionRadius: radius around sampled cells affected in diminishing mode; defaults to 0
samplingRules.rules.sampling.depletionFactor: value multiplier for depleted samples in diminishing mode; defaults to 0
samplingRules.rules.sampling.cooldownWindows: planning windows before a cooldown sample recovers full value; defaults to 0
samplingRules.rules.sampling.persistentWindowMultiplie: repeat-per-window multiplier for monitoring missions; defaults to 1

priorityTargetRules.rules.priorityTargets.enabled: boolean; defaults to true when level priority targets exist
priorityTargetRules.rules.priorityTargets.showFutureTargets: optional planning display hint; defaults to false
priorityTargetRules.rules.priorityTargets.showActiveOnly: optional planning display hint; defaults to true
priorityTargetRules.scoring.priorityTargetValueMultiplier: multiplier applied to target.value when captured; defaults to 1
priorityTargetRules.scoring.allowSharedPriorityCapture: if true multiple agents may receive capture events for the same target; defaults to false

stochasticRules.rules.stochasticSeed: optional deterministic seed for per-cell probabilistic ROI outcomes

driftRules.rules.drift.mode: deterministic | forecastUncertain; defaults to deterministic unless stochasticDrift is true
driftRules.rules.drift.driftGain: optional current drift multiplier; falls back to mission.physics.driftGain
driftRules.rules.drift.stochasticDrift: boolean; when true, simulation perturbs truth current with deterministic seeded noise
driftRules.rules.drift.noiseScale: current-vector noise magnitude used only when stochasticDrift is true
driftRules.rules.drift.seed: optional deterministic seed for stochastic drift noise

navigationUncertaintyRules.rules.navigationUncertainty.level: off | low | medium | high; controls dead-reckoning cone growth while underwater
navigationUncertaintyRules.rules.navigationUncertainty.seeded: when true, true-position offset samples are deterministic from the challenge replay seed anchor
navigationUncertaintyRules.rules.navigationUncertainty.gpsCorrectio: when true, surfacing acts as a GPS fix/replan point
navigationUncertaintyRules.rules.navigationUncertainty.showCone: planning UI/export hint to show likely surfacing/dead-reckoning uncertainty regions
navigationUncertaintyRules.rules.navigationUncertainty.baseConeWidt: initial cone radius contribution in cells
navigationUncertaintyRules.rules.navigationUncertainty.growthPerHou: cone radius growth per underwater hour before surfacing correction

notes: Readable schema-like documentation; validation is lightweight/manual. Mission objectives are optional; campaign defaults are generated when missing.
